entities.summary: Jan Zygmunt Deybel von Hammerau or Johann Sigmund Deybel was a Rococo architect from thr Electorate of Saxony mainly active in Poland. He also served as a captain then as a major (1746) in the Polish artillery — his son was the general Krystian Godfryd Deybel de Hammerau.
